description: Track any parcel by its tracking number. No account needed. Works for parcels shipped through this service with any carrier, and for most Canadian carrier numbers (Canada Post, UPS, FedEx, Purolator, Nationex, GLS). Returns the current status, the estimated or actual delivery date and the carrier's latest scans, plus a link to the full tracking page. Use this whenever someone asks where a parcel is.

lang.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the user's locale, then to the site's language.

title: Track a package
